instruction: Put the yellow pen in the green pen case.

attempts.code:
candidates = grasp_candidates("yellow_pen")
best_candidate = None
best_score = -1
for c in candidates:
    if c["fits_open_fingers"] and abs(c["yaw"] - (c["object_long_axis_yaw"] + 0.5 * 3.1416)) < 0.1:
        if c["score"] > best_score:
            best_score = c["score"]
            best_candidate = c
if best_candidate is None:
    best_candidate = candidates[0]

grasp(best_candidate)
if not observe()["gripper"]["holding_something"]:
    raise RuntimeError("Failed to grasp yellow_pen")

spots = free_spots("green_case", "yellow_pen")
if not spots["spots"]:
    raise RuntimeError("No free spot in green_case")

spot = spots["spots"][0]
target_yaw = spot["object_long_axis_yaw"]  # align pen long axis with green_case
gripper_yaw_at_grasp = best_candidate["yaw"]
object_long_axis_at_grasp = best_candidate["object_long_axis_yaw"]
delta_yaw = target_yaw - object_long_axis_at_grasp + (gripper_yaw_at_grasp - best_candidate["object_long_axis_yaw"])
rotate_by(delta_yaw)

carry_to(spot["x"], spot["y"], height=0.18, yaw=None)
lower_until_contact()
open_gripper()
retreat(dz=0.12)
